title: Tim Knight Says Stocks Just Flashed a Reversal Right After Lifetime Highs
speaker: Tim Knight (Slope of Hope) on tastylive

macro_themes.view: Bond market has historically led equities lower; stocks run on the AI narrative but will eventually wake up.
Rates keep trending higher; interest is 14% of the federal budget - a vicious cycle.
Gold, silver, stocks and crypto are tethered; only crude oil trades on its own geopolitical drivers.
Stunned the VIX is so low; expects a very interesting rest of 2026.

calls.reason: Bearish engulfing pattern and a small failed bullish breakout back below the breakout horizontal after lifetime highs.
calls.quote: we've got a bearish engulfing pattern at the moment um based on today's action

calls.condition: Holds bullish structure while above the breakout level.
calls.reason: Gave back recent gains but has not sunk below the breakout level.
calls.quote: the ENQ hasn't given up the ghost yet.

calls.reason: Dow in a down channel since an Aug 5 shooting star, thousands of points from record highs; reshorted DIA, his biggest position.
calls.quote: I I reshorted the DIIA yesterday and it was my biggest uh position and my only meaningful ETF position

calls.reason: Topping pattern and fell even on a record-high day; added to the short; could hold weeks or months; stop tightened.
calls.quote: if if if something's down and it should be up, sell it, or in my case, short more of it.

calls.reason: Opportunistic short after the politically driven pop on Monday; plans to exit before the runoff election.
calls.quote: This was just opportunistic because it popped so high um on Monday based on that.

calls.reason: Bitcoin stalled after a big run-up and is down ~$3,000 today; MSTR short held below a horizontal ray, added and stop tightened to just above yesterday's low.
calls.quote: you could do worse than shorting MSTR if you wanted to be short crypto.

calls.condition: Real test is whether ~150 holds; does not expect a break under 100.
calls.reason: Failed at the ~170 July high; weak market plus news of raising $40B to buy Nvidia chips; could slump to ~150 and to 110-120 by around March.
calls.quote: I wouldn't be surprised to see this kind of slump uh back down to the 150ish area.

calls.reason: Strong run in recent months with lots of overhead supply; trades highly correlated with SpaceX.
calls.quote: I'm short Tesla, not based on SpaceX

calls.reason: Long-term enthusiastic, but gold is moving with equities and is down with them today.
calls.quote: as enthusiastic as I'm about gold and silver in the long term, um they still seem to be sort of at the mercy of whatever …

calls.reason: Down ~2.5% but today's low perfectly kissed the supporting trend line; long-term enthusiastic.
calls.quote: silver is at least respecting um that trend line.

calls.reason: Bond downtrend is clear; rates just keep going higher amid rising debt needs.
calls.quote: the trend is clear. You know, we get occasional green bars just just to be nice from time to time, but uh, rates just keep …

notes: Date: 'runoff elections in 18 days' (Brazil runoff Oct 25) and ES 'closed at lifetime highs yesterday' -> Wed 2026-10-07 (listing approx_date 2026-10-08). SpaceX ticker unknown (recorded as 'SPACEX'; 'basics' in transcript = SpaceX); 110-120 range recorded as midpoint 115 medium-term target (by ~March, so arguably long_term). 'DIIA' = DIA, 'KU'/'KRU' = KORU, 'Alain factor' = Elon factor. Bitcoin view expressed only via MSTR short. Crude described as geopolitically driven, no bias.
